[Benzinga news, 2026-10-26T19:02:03Z, by staff] Pfizer Receives FDA Approval for TALZENNA Combination Therapy
The U.S. FDA has approved the use of Pfizer's TALZENNA (talazoparib) in combination with XTANDI for the treatment of specific prostate cancer patients.
Pfizer announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted approval for the use of TALZENNA (talazoparib) in combination with XTANDI for the treatment of patients with mAPMN/S prostate cancer harboring HRR gene mutations. TALZENNA is an oral PARP inhibitor designed to block enzyme activity involved in DNA damage repair. This regulatory approval expands the therapeutic options available for patients with this specific genetic profile, marking a significant development for Pfizer's oncology portfolio.
